newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Sugar passes on 10,000T US corn tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Sugar passes on 10,000T US corn tender.

text.p: State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp on Wednesday passed on a tender for a 10,000-tonne U.S. corn shipment as only one bid was offered, traders said.
Taiwan's government requires at least two bidders in a state-held public tender, a Taiwan Sugar official said.
The tender had specified that sellers could opt delivery during any 20-day window in June.
Traders said the relatively small 10,000-tonne shipment size attracted little interest from suppliers.
Traders have said that Taiwan Sugar would tender on Friday for a combined shipment of 20,000 tonnes of U.S. corn and 10,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans.
